title: PeachyPet service registration
description: One file per service in ~/.peachypet/services/<id>.json. The file name is the id: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

kind.description: service: long-running, has start/stop/restart. task: runs to completion.

command.description: One shell line, run with the user's login shell (zsh -lc).

port.description: Port the service listens on; used for running status.

note.description: One-line note shown under the name.
